name: paymydine-desktop
description: PayMyDine Desktop App: canonical tenant Platform UI with persistent in-memory page views, durable MHTML/data cache, secure payments, printer and cash drawer support.

scripts.check: node --check src/local-first-entry.js && node --check src/local-cache-privacy.js && node --check src/local-first-bootstrap.js && node --check src/fast-route-pool.js && node --check src/local-store.js && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/external-preload.js && node --check src/setup.js && node --check src/hardware.js && node --check src/receipt.js && node --check src/hardware-page.js && node --check src/offline.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run check && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run check && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
